Critical UI flows validated: /consumables list with subcategory tabs, /consumable/:id detail with SEO meta, universal search at /search?q=Brother shows correct counts across all 5 categories, footer legal badge shows correct version/date text, and the Buy Now 404 bug fix is confirmed — guests clicking Buy now on consumable detail get AuthRequiredDialog and 'Create account' navigates to /register?next=... minor.issue: Backend logs show transient 'column suppliers.contact_email does not exist' postgrest error from a related joined query path; functional endpoints still return 200 due to graceful fallback. Worth cleaning up the select list.

issues: A 'Set your location' tooltip/popover overlays the top navigation on every page load and partially covers the OEM Marketplace pill. Consider auto-dismissing or repositioning so it doesn't sit over nav items.

action_items: Optional cleanup: Remove the dangling 'contact_email' column reference in suppliers join inside consumable-related endpoint (visible in backend.err.log).
Optional UX: Auto-dismiss / reposition the city tooltip so it doesn't overlay the nav row.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 4627 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Strongly recommend splitting into routers (consumables.py, search.py, orders.py, suppliers.py, auth.py) and a services module. Currently all routes live in one giant file.

create_consumable uses an exception-driven retry loop that pops keys when Postgres complains they don't exist. This works but masks schema drift; prefer a single introspection at startup that builds the allowed-column set and trims the insert row up front.
In-memory rate limiter (_RATE_BUCKETS) won't survive process restart or scale across multiple workers — fine for now, but flag for production hardening.
